subject: Sentinel AI: proposed evaluation playbook & trial timelines
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@sentinel.ai>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@sentinel.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Sentinel AI: proposed evaluation playbook & trial timelines

Hi Elena / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our demo and the concrete proposal for a short evaluation we think will show value quickly. I attached a one‑page draft playbook (evaluation-playbook-draft.pdf) — below is the same in email form so it's easy to comment on.

Objective
- Validate that Redwood reduces per-token cost by >40% for your high-throughput inference flows while meeting 99th percentile latency target for inference.

Scope (what we'll test)
- 2 representative models: the internal summarization model + customer-facing reranker
- Production-like traffic pattern (burst to 200 qps, steady 40 qps)
- A subset of real queries (sample of ~10k requests you can provide) and synthetic stress tests

Success criteria (suggested)
- Latency: 99th percentile end-to-end inference < 450ms for the reranker under steady load
- Cost: batch + cache configuration reduces per-token compute cost >= 40% vs current baseline
- Accuracy/regression: token-level generation quality within ±2% of baseline on the standard eval set (we'll run A/B eval)

Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (kickoff): finalize success criteria, data access, and test harness (owners: Logan / Rajiv)
- Week 1: Sandbox prep — model variants, quantization profiles, data ingest (owners: Karthik / Sentinel eng)
- Week 2: Trial run (24–72h steady-state + burst windows) — collect metrics 
- Week 3: Analysis & recommendations, canary rollout plan if successful

Ownership
- Redwood: Logan (project lead), Karthik (solutions engineering), Marissa (CS onboarding)
- Sentinel: Rajiv (eng owner), procurement for contract/terms, named data steward for access

Immediate asks from you
1) Confirm the success criteria above or flag any additions (e.g., security/privacy SLOs).
2) Provide a short sample of 10k de-identified requests and a contact for S3 access, or let us know if we should use a synthetic sample to start.
3) Procurement point-of-contact so we can surface the trial MSA/do DPA early.

Next steps
- If the criteria look right, I'll send a calendar invite for a 30m kickoff and attach a slightly expanded playbook.

Appreciate the quick feedback — happy to adjust the success metrics to match internal priorities.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: evaluation-playbook-draft.pdf
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@sentinel.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@sentinel.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Sentinel AI: proposed evaluation playbook & trial timelines

Logan — thanks for the thorough recap and the doc. Quick responses inline: 

- Objective: yes, cost reduction + maintaining model quality is the primary metric for the business team. Also important: maintain inference latency for interactive features (we care about p95 and p99).
- Scope: the two models outlined are correct. We'll provide a de-identified sample.
- Success criteria: The latency target should be p99 < 400ms for the reranker under steady load — can you drive to p99 400ms rather than 450ms? Also, we need to track tail-latency for bursts.

Privacy/security note:
- All sample data must be de-identified and delivered via our S3 staging bucket. Our security team requires a short questionnaire before data transfer; I've attached the data access form.

Procurement/Legal:
- Procurement will need a draft MSA with trial terms (term length, liability, data handling). I looped in procurement (procurement@sentinel.ai) on this thread.

Timeline:
- We're targeting a go/no-go decision for vendor selection by the end of week 4 (we're aggressive on this). Can you confirm if the proposed Week 1–3 plan can be compressed by a few days?

Thanks — Elena
Elena Ruiz
VP Product, Sentinel AI
elena@sentinel.ai

Attachments: sentinel-data-access-form.xlsx
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@sentinel.ai>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@sentinel.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sentinel AI: proposed evaluation playbook & trial timelines

Elena — appreciate the clarity. Short answers: yes, we can tighten the latency target to p99 < 400ms for the reranker and include burst-tail tracking in the runbook. To meet your week-4 vendor decision, we propose compressing the timeline slightly: 

Revised timeline (compressed)
- Day 0 (kickoff, within 48h of data access confirmation): finalize criteria + security handoff
- Days 1–3: Sandbox prep and ingest (we'll parallelize: Karthik will set up model variants while Sentinel prepares S3 access)
- Days 4–6: Trial run (48–72h steady-state with scheduled burst windows)
- Day 7–9: Analysis & results deck; decision support (can extend for deeper analysis if wanted)

If we start Day 0 by next Tuesday (June 8), that puts vendor selection comfortably within your week-4 window. 

Owners
- Redwood: Logan (project lead, kickoff), Karthik (solution engineering, sandbox + test harness), Marissa (CS for onboarding + runbook ops)
- Sentinel: Rajiv (eng lead), Elena (product), procurement contact for contract review

Logistics
- Rajiv — can you share the S3 staging path and the data steward contact?
- Procurement — do you have a preferred redline process & point-of-contact? We'll share a short trial MSA and a DPA template.

I've added our HubSpot deal (HS-12893) and a shared folder here: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b3c-eval-playbook

I'll send a tentative 30m kickoff invite for June 8 local times — please adjust if needed: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meetings/logan/15min

Thanks — team ready to move quickly.

—Logan

- I'll own the onboarding checklist and the weekly operational sync. Proposal: 30m recurring on Mondays during the trial window.

- For trial SLOs we'll keep an operational dashboard (I can provision a shared dashboard in the Redwood Console and grant Sentinel a viewer link).

2) Confirm internal stakeholders for daily ~15min standups during the run window
3) Point procurement contact for contract redlines

I'll upload the checklist to the shared folder once we confirm kickoff time.
